messages:
Maddie L: Quick sync — we need to finalize the v2 rollout plan. Who's owning migration for /predict and /embed? Product set 2026-06-01 as the deprecation target, want owners + blockers listed.

Alex P: I can own /predict. I have PRs for the v2 router but runtime compat tests are failing on the kv-cache path when quantized. PRs: runtime change + router update. CC @Sam R for infra flakes.

Sam R: I'll take a look at the kv-cache flake. We saw a GC/host memory spike in the dedicated nightly that lines up with the failing test. Trying to repro locally now, should have an update by EOD. :hammer_and_wrench: 

Jordan K: SDK side: JS + Python generators are blocked on the streaming chunk header schema change. We need a definitive API shape and a short migration guide with examples. Targeting SDK releases next Tue — need confirmation on streaming iterator shape.

Nina S: 2026-06-01 deprec date is firm from product/legal. We prefer a phased deprecation: opt-in header -> 30d notice -> disable. Also need telemetry per-tenant for v1 usage so sales can reach out to high-usage customers.

Maddie L: Owners so far: Alex (/predict), Jordan (SDK), Sam (infra). Can someone take /embed migration? @Carlos M?

Carlos M: I'll own /embed. Heads up: model aliasing changed (old embed names -> rwd-embed-v2). I can add a backwards-compatible alias shim but it needs quick perf tests. I'll open a ticket.

Jordan K: Proposed SDK snippet for v2 streaming pattern (please sanity check):
```js
const res = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'rwd-2', messages });
for await (const chunk of res) {
  console.log(chunk.delta);
}
```
We want to standardize on the async iterator API rather than event callbacks.

Alex P: Approved for the iterator shape. Canary plan: route 10% of production hostnames to the v2 router next week and collect latency + error rates. Rollback if error rate > 1% over 5m. Need ops to create the alert and a rollback playbook.

Sam R: Ops added alert channel infra-alerts#v2-canary with threshold 0.8% over 5m. Also added tracing tags: `api_version` and `router_variant`.

Maddie L: Action items recap: Alex -> canary playbook + router PR; Jordan -> update SDK changelog + migration snippets; Carlos -> alias shim ticket + perf smoke; Sam -> root-cause kv-cache flake + hotfix if needed. I'll assemble owners doc and loop in legal for deprecation notice. Please post PR/issue links here when created.

Alex P: Runtime PR: https://git.redwood/infr/runtime/pulls/512 (tests failing on kv-cache currently). Router PR: https://git.redwood/net/router/pulls/128 (ready for review).

Jordan K: SDK PRs (drafts): python https://git.redwood/sdk/python/pulls/301, js https://git.redwood/sdk/js/pulls/404 — both have migration snippets and draft changelogs.

Carlos M: Alias shim ticket created: https://issues.redwood/embed-shim-229. I'll attach perf numbers once smoke tests complete.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-04-21 03:00 UTC (10% routing).

Maddie L: Great. If anyone expects delays that would block the canary window, call it out now so we can reschedule. Otherwise I'll update the project board and start a short README for migration owners. :thumbsup:
